Emily Feng is a White House correspondent for NPR, where she previously spent years as a foreign correspondent covering China, Taiwan and the wider region. Previously she worked for the Financial Times from Beijing. Her reporting has won two Human Rights Press Awards, two Gracies, the Shorenstein Journalism Award, the Daniel Schorr Prize and earned an Overseas Press Club citation in 2025.
